verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 3.21
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 3.21

verses.pali: 3. Puggalavagga
verses.english: 3. Individuals

verses.pali: Samiddhasutta
verses.english: With Saviṭṭha

verses.pali: Evaṁ me sutaṁ—
verses.english: So I have heard.

verses.pali: ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā ca samiddho āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhiko yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkamiṁsu; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṁ sammodiṁsu.
verses.english: Then Venerable Saviṭṭha and Venerable Mahākoṭṭhita went up to Venerable Sāriputta, and exchanged greetings with him.

verses.pali: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdiṁsu. Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho āyasmantaṁ samiddhaṁ āyasmā sāriputto etadavoca:
verses.english: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, they sat down to one side and Venerable Sāriputta said to Venerable Saviṭṭha,

verses.pali: “Tayome, āvuso samiddha, puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: “Reverend Saviṭṭha, these three individuals are found in the world.

verses.pali: Katame tayo?
verses.english: What three?

verses.pali: Kāyasakkhī, diṭṭhippatto, saddhāvimutto.
verses.english: The direct witness, the one attained to view, and the one freed by faith.

verses.pali: Ime kho, āvuso, tayo puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: These are the three individuals found in the world.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ, āvuso, tiṇṇaṁ puggalānaṁ katamo te puggalo khamati abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā”ti?
verses.english: Of these three individuals, who do you believe to be the finest?”

verses.pali: “Tayome, āvuso sāriputta, puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: “Reverend Sāriputta, these three individuals are found in the world.

verses.pali: Katame tayo?
verses.english: What three?

verses.pali: Kāyasakkhī, diṭṭhippatto, saddhāvimutto.
verses.english: The direct witness, the one attained to view, and the one freed by faith.

verses.pali: Ime kho, āvuso, tayo puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: These are the three individuals found in the world.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ, āvuso, tiṇṇaṁ puggalānaṁ yvāyaṁ puggalo saddhāvimutto, ayaṁ me puggalo khamati imesaṁ tiṇṇaṁ puggalānaṁ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.
verses.english: Of these three individuals, I believe the individual freed by faith to be finest.

verses.pali: Taṁ kissa hetu?
verses.english: Why is that?

verses.pali: Imassa, āvuso, puggalassa saddhindriyaṁ adhimattan”ti.
verses.english: Because this individual’s faculty of faith is extraordinary.”

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṁ mahākoṭṭhikaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then Sāriputta said to Mahākoṭṭhita,

verses.pali: “tayome, āvuso koṭṭhika, puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: “Reverend Koṭṭhika, these three individuals are found in the world.

verses.pali: Katame tayo?
verses.english: What three?

verses.pali: Kāyasakkhī, diṭṭhippatto, saddhāvimutto.
verses.english: The direct witness, the one attained to view, and the one freed by faith.

verses.pali: Ime kho, āvuso, tayo puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: These are the three individuals found in the world.

verses.english: Of these three individuals, who do you believe to be the finest?”

verses.pali: “Tayome, āvuso koṭṭhika, puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: “Reverend Koṭṭhika, these three individuals are found in the world.

verses.english: What three?

verses.english: The direct witness, the one attained to view, and the one freed by faith.

verses.english: Of these three individuals, I believe the individual attained to view to be finest.

verses.english: Why is that?

verses.pali: Imassa, āvuso, puggalassa paññindriyaṁ adhimattan”ti.
verses.english: Because this individual’s faculty of wisdom is extraordinary.”

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantañca samiddhaṁ āyasmantañca mahākoṭṭhikaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then Sāriputta said to Saviṭṭha and Mahākoṭṭhita,

verses.pali: “byākataṁ kho, āvuso, amhehi sabbeheva yathāsakaṁ paṭibhānaṁ.
verses.english: “Each of us has spoken from the heart.

verses.pali: Āyāmāvuso, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamissāma; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato etamatthaṁ ārocessāma.
verses.english: Come, reverends, let’s go to the Buddha, and tell him about this.

verses.pali: Yathā no bhagavā byākarissati tathā naṁ dhāressāmā”ti.
verses.english: As he answers, so we’ll remember it.”

verses.pali: “Evamāvuso”ti kho āyasmā ca samiddho āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhiko āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṁ.
verses.english: “Yes, reverend,” they replied.

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca samiddho āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhiko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṁsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdiṁsu.
verses.english: Then Sāriputta, Saviṭṭha, and Mahākoṭṭhita went up to the Buddha, bowed, and sat down to one side.

verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto yāvatako ahosi āyasmatā ca samiddhena āyasmatā ca mahākoṭṭhikena saddhiṁ kathāsallāpo taṁ sabbaṁ bhagavato ārocesi.
verses.english: Then Sāriputta told the Buddha of all they had discussed.

verses.pali: “Na khvettha, sāriputta, sukaraṁ ekaṁsena byākātuṁ:
verses.english: “In this matter, Sāriputta, it’s not easy to categorically declare that

verses.pali: ‘ayaṁ imesaṁ tiṇṇaṁ puggalānaṁ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā’ti.
verses.english: one of these three individuals is finest.

verses.pali: Ṭhānañhetaṁ, sāriputta, vijjati yvāyaṁ puggalo saddhāvimutto svāssa arahattāya paṭipanno, yvāyaṁ puggalo kāyasakkhī svāssa sakadāgāmī vā anāgāmī vā, yo cāyaṁ puggalo diṭṭhippatto sopassa sakadāgāmī vā anāgāmī vā.
verses.english: In some cases, an individual freed by faith is practicing for perfection, while the direct witness and the one attained to view are once-returners or non-returners.

verses.pali: Na khvettha, sāriputta, sukaraṁ ekaṁsena byākātuṁ:
verses.english: In this matter, it’s not easy to categorically declare that

verses.pali: ‘ayaṁ imesaṁ tiṇṇaṁ puggalānaṁ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā’ti.
verses.english: one of these three individuals is finest.

verses.pali: ‘ayaṁ imesaṁ tiṇṇaṁ puggalānaṁ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā’”ti.

verses.pali: Paṭhamaṁ.
